options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: descr
options.description: A description for this IPsec phase 2 entry.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disables this IPsec phase 2 entry.

options.name: encryption_algorithm_option
options.description: The encryption algorithms to be used by this phase 2 entry.

options.name: hash_algorithm_option
options.description: The hashing algorithms used by this IPsec phase 2 entry. Note: Hash is ignored with GCM algorithms. SHA1 provides weak security and should be avoided.

options.name: ikeid
options.description: The `ikeid` of the parent IPsec phase 1 entry this IPsec phase 2 entry belongs to.

options.name: keepalive
options.description: Enables or disables checking this P2 and initiating if disconnected; does not send traffic inside the tunnel. This check ignores the P1 option 'Child SA Start Action' and works for both VTI and tunnel mode P2s. For IKEv2 without split connections, this only needs to be enabled on one P2.

options.name: lifetime
options.description: The hard IKE SA lifetime (in seconds) after which the IKE SA will be expired.

options.name: localid_address
options.description: The local network IP component of this IPsec security association.

options.name: localid_netbits
options.description: The subnet bits of the `localid_address` network.

options.name: localid_type
options.description: The local ID type to use for this phase 2 entry. Valid value options are: an existing interface, `address`, `network`. For interface values, the `:ip` modifier can be appended to the value to use the interface's IP address instead of its entire subnet.

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: mode
options.description: The IPsec phase 2 mode this entry will use.

options.name: natlocalid_address
options.description: The NAT/BINAT local network IP component of this IPsec security association.

options.name: natlocalid_netbits
options.description: The subnet bits of the `natlocalid_address` network.

options.name: natlocalid_type
options.description: The NAT/BINAT translation type for this IPsec phase 2 entry. Leave as `null` if NAT/BINAT is not needed. Valid value options are: an existing interface, `address`, `network`. For interface values, the `:ip` modifier can be appended to the value to use the interface's IP address instead of its entire subnet.

options.name: pfsgroup
options.description: The PFS key group this IPsec phase 2 entry should use. Note: Groups 1, 2, 5, 22, 23, and 24 provide weak security and should be avoided.

options.name: pinghost
options.description: The IP address to send an ICMP echo request to inside the tunnel. Can trigger initiation of a tunnel mode P2, but does not trigger initiation of a VTI mode P2.

options.name: protocol
options.description: the IPsec phase 2 proposal protocol for this entry. Encapsulating Security Payload (`esp`) performs encryption and authentication, Authentication Header (`ah`) is authentication only.

options.name: rand_time
options.description: A random value up to this amount will be subtracted from the `rekey_time` and `reauth_time` to avoid simultaneous renegotiation.

options.name: rekey_time
options.description: The amount of time (in seconds) before an IKE SA establishes new keys.

options.name: remoteid_address
options.description: The remote network IP component of this IPsec security association.

options.name: remoteid_netbits
options.description: The subnet bits of the `remoteid_address` network.

options.name: remoteid_type
options.description: The remote ID type to use for this phase 2 entry. Valid value options are: `address`, `network`. For interface values, the `:ip` modifier can be appended to the value to use the interface's IP address instead of its entire subnet.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
